findings.basis: Pedagogy explicitly maps matriculation, learning, evaluation, execution, monitoring, and review to A01-A12.
Professor, independent evaluator, and IMHOTEP authorities are distinct.
No module, transfer, or thesis success can be asserted without external artifacts/evaluation.
Pedagogy version can be reverted while preserving evidence and A12 lessons.
No cohort has yet generated observed learning or thesis evidence under this pedagogy.

condition: Treat this as approved pedagogy architecture, not proof that the pedagogy improves learning. A12 must compare observed cohort outcomes against the stated effectiveness measures.
